description: This file declares the interface for managing temperature-related functionalities for a device, including retrieving current temperature and thresholds, and setting thresholds.

methods.name: mfrGetTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the current temperature of the core along with the temperature state (normal, high, critical).

methods.name: mfrSetTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets temperature thresholds which determine the temperature state reported.

methods.name: mfrGetTempThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves the current temperature thresholds for high and critical states.

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_CRITICAL
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_CRITICAL       \/* Temp is critical, should trigger a thermal reset *\/$/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_HIGH
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_HIGH,          \/* Temp is high, but just a warning as device can still opera/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_NORMAL
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_NORMAL = 0,    \/* Temp is within normal operating range *\/$/
